description: Indian luxury fragrance house making 'quiet luxury' eau de parfum and solid perfume balms in India; cruelty-free, with five fragrances crafted and a small, growing wearer base per its own site.

evidence.summary: KAEORN's own ambassador page states 'No cap on earnings' (shown with the infinity symbol) and publishes tiered commission: 10% for 0-10 sales, 15% for 11-50 sales, 20% for 51+ sales, plus a 50% ambassador discount and a personal creator code giving the audience 10% off; commissions are paid monthly with no minimum threshold.

The same page sets application requirements: follow @kaeorn.co on Instagram, have personally used at least one Kaeorn fragrance, and post 1 Reel + 2 Stories at launch; applications are reviewed personally within 48 hours, and ambassador content may be reposted and used by the brand across its site, socials and ads with credit.
The program terms on the ambassador page publish kaeornwellness@gmail.com as the email for ambassador order processing.
KAEORN's homepage brands its perfumes 'MADE IN INDIA' with pricing in rupees, and states 5 fragrances crafted, 150 happy wearers and 100% cruelty free.

name: KAEORN

reasons.compensation: Verified uncapped earnings on the brand's own page with published tiers of 10/15/20% and monthly payouts with no minimum threshold.
reasons.contact_access: Open application form on the official program page plus a published program email (kaeornwellness@gmail.com).
reasons.credibility: Very small, young brand (five fragrances, ~150 wearers per its own site), so track record is thin despite the strong published terms.
reasons.niche_fit: Pure fragrance brand in the beauty niche; scent content is a proven creator category, though narrower than skincare/makeup.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Applications are publicly open now and reviewed within 48 hours per the program page.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A structured ambassador program built around creator Reels and Stories, with brand reuse rights for ambassador content across ads and socials.

description: Hungarian luxury skincare brand built on the mineral-rich thermal waters of Hungary, with a zero-nasties formulation policy, sold through its own site including a US storefront.

evidence.summary: Awin's own merchant profile for the Omorovicza US affiliate programme lists standard commission rates: Default 5%, Existing Customers 5%, New Customers 7%; the programme is run by the THG Ingenuity affiliate team and offers exclusive affiliate discounts and regular creative updates.

The Awin profile describes Omorovicza as built on Hungary's healing thermal waters, with a zero-nasties policy excluding parabens, mineral oils, silicones, phthalates and synthetic fragrances, and links purchases to omorovicza.com.

name: Omorovicza

reasons.compensation: Published network rates: 5% default and 7% on new customers per Awin's own merchant profile.
reasons.contact_access: No public email found; contact runs through the Awin programme team (THG Ingenuity).
reasons.credibility: Long-established luxury brand, part of the THG group, with international retail presence.
reasons.niche_fit: Pure luxury skincare with strong ingredient storytelling - squarely in the skincare creator niche.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open affiliate programme on Awin that publishers can apply to join.
reasons.ugc_evidence: An established network affiliate programme with affiliate promotions and creative support, but no creator-specific ambassador structure was found.

description: US online beauty retailer (part of the THG/Lookfantastic group) carrying 350+ premium skincare, makeup and hair brands across 16,000+ products.

evidence.summary: Lasso's program listing gives SkinStore at 8% per sale with a 1-day cookie and $50 payout threshold, and describes it as an authorized retailer to hundreds of premium beauty brands including SkinCeuticals, Dermalogica and Caudalie.
This skincare affiliate roundup states the SkinStore affiliate program is run through Commission Junction (CJ Affiliate) and offers an 8% commission rate.

Olavivo's skincare program list also records SkinStore at 8% per sale and notes its catalogue of over 350 brands and 16,000 products; some other aggregators quote 'up to' ranges (5-10%, up to 12%), while three program listings agree on the 8% figure recorded here.

name: SkinStore

reasons.compensation: 8% per sale corroborated by three program listings (Lasso, AmalinksPro, Olavivo), though the 1-day cookie is short.
reasons.contact_access: No public creator contact found; access is through the CJ Affiliate programme only.
reasons.credibility: Founded in 1997 and part of THG since 2016 - a long-running, major beauty retailer.
reasons.niche_fit: Beauty retailer led by premium skincare - a strong fit for skincare and beauty creators who recommend across brands.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open affiliate programme on CJ Affiliate that publishers can apply to join.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A standard network affiliate programme; no creator-specific ambassador or UGC structure was found.

description: Professional-grade US skincare brand founded by skin therapists, selling cleansers, treatments and SPF through its own site and salons; the consumer affiliate route runs through CJ Affiliate.

evidence.summary: LinkClicky's affiliate directory lists Dermalogica's consumer program on CJ Affiliate at 3% per sale, with dermalogica.com as the program website.
Published rates conflict: LinkClicky lists 3% per sale on CJ, Shopper quotes 4% and up to 5-10%, and LinkApprove quotes up to 8% - so commission_rate is recorded as null rather than guessing.

Dermalogica's separate professional track (via Refersion, for skin therapists) pays 15% commission in Product Credit Vouchers only; the brand is included on the strength of its cash-paying CJ consumer program, not this voucher-only pro track.
Snippet's check of November 16, 2026 found no affiliate, influencer or ambassador program and no PR email published on dermalogica.com's own pages; the consumer route is the network program.

name: Dermalogica

reasons.compensation: Rate could not be verified: published sources conflict (3% vs 4% vs up to 8%), so it is recorded as null and scored low.
reasons.contact_access: No published PR or creator email; contact is through the CJ programme only.
reasons.credibility: One of the best-known professional skincare brands worldwide, sold through salons and its own stores.
reasons.niche_fit: Pure professional skincare with strong education-led content potential - a core skincare creator niche brand.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Consumer affiliate programme is joinable via CJ Affiliate, subject to network approval.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A live consumer affiliate programme exists on CJ, but no open creator/ambassador structure is published on the brand's own pages.

description: US clinical skincare brand founded in 2000, known for mineral SPF and complexion products, selling through its own site and professional partners.

evidence.summary: Lasso's program listing gives Colorescience at 5% per sale with a 30-day cookie.

Colorescience's own careers page describes its influencer and creator affiliate programs end to end - sourcing, gifting, paid partnerships and commissionable links - run across ShopMy, LTK, YouTube Shopping and CJ, confirming CJ as one of its affiliate channels and an actively staffed creator program.
Sovrn's merchant profile describes Colorescience as a US skincare and cosmetics brand founded in 2000 by Diane Ranger, focused on mineral sun protection and complexion formulas.

name: Colorescience

reasons.compensation: 5% per sale with a 30-day cookie per Lasso's program listing - modest but published.
reasons.contact_access: No public creator email found (only a careers inbox); access runs through its affiliate channels.
reasons.credibility: Established clinical brand founded in 2000, widely stocked by dermatology practices and retailers.
reasons.niche_fit: Pure skincare/SPF brand - a core niche for skincare creators, especially sun-protection content.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Affiliate access via CJ and creator platforms (ShopMy, LTK, YouTube Shopping) per the brand's own careers page.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The brand staffs a dedicated Influencer & Affiliate Manager role covering gifting, paid partnerships and commissionable creator links - clear evidence of an active creator program.

description: French luxury beauty house (L'Oréal) selling skincare, makeup and fragrance through its own regional sites, with affiliate programmes run per-region on networks including Awin.

evidence.summary: Awin's Lancôme UK programme profile offers 5% baseline commission on each sale with a 30-day cookie window, and states the programme is managed by Acquire, contactable at loreal@acquire.co.uk.
PostAffiliatePro's directory lists the Lancôme affiliate program on the Awin network at 5% commission, single-tier, with monthly payouts and no minimum payout.

Rates vary by region and network: LinkClicky lists Lancôme on Impact for AU/CA at 7.7% and 2-4%, and US figures of 5-10% are reported elsewhere, so no single global rate is recorded; commission_rate is null and the verified UK Awin baseline is 5%.

name: Lancôme

reasons.compensation: A verified 5% UK baseline exists on Awin, but rates conflict across regions and networks (up to 7.7%/10% reported), so the global rate is recorded as null.
reasons.contact_access: A published programme contact email (loreal@acquire.co.uk, via the Awin profile) plus network application routes.
reasons.credibility: One of the world's largest luxury beauty brands, part of L'Oréal.
reasons.niche_fit: Luxury skincare, makeup and fragrance icon - near-perfect fit for beauty creators.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Affiliate programmes are open per region on Awin (and Impact in AU/CA), subject to approval.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Regional network affiliate programmes with creator traffic explicitly accepted; no single global ambassador program was found.

description: Dermatologist-developed, plant-powered skincare line created by Dr. Gary Goldfaden (Cosmesis Skincare, Hollywood, Florida), bringing his in-office treatments to retail since 2013.

evidence.summary: Lasso's program listing gives Goldfaden MD at 20% per sale, and its join links point to ShareASale.
Goldfaden MD's own terms name the operator as Cosmesis Skincare, Inc. of Hollywood, Florida, United States, and publish contact@goldfaden.com for inquiries.
The brand's about page describes dermatologist Dr. Gary Goldfaden's in-office formulas, brought to the wider public as the Goldfaden MD line in 2013.

name: Goldfaden MD

reasons.compensation: 20% per sale per Lasso's program listing - one of the highest rates in this batch, though single-sourced.
reasons.contact_access: A published general email (contact@goldfaden.com) on the brand's own site; no dedicated creator inbox found.
reasons.credibility: Established dermatologist brand operating since 2013 with national retail and media presence.
reasons.niche_fit: Pure dermatologist-developed skincare - squarely in the skincare creator niche.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open affiliate programme via ShareASale that publishers can apply to join.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A live network affiliate programme; no separate ambassador structure was found on the brand's own pages.

description: Plastic-surgeon-developed anti-aging skincare brand from Drs. John Layke and Payman Danielpour of Beverly Hills Plastic Surgery Group, sold direct through its own site.

evidence.summary: Lasso's listing for the Beverly Hills MD (US) program gives 10% per sale with a 30-day cookie, and its join links point to Awin (ui.awin.com).
The brand's own site presents Beverly Hills MD as skincare developed by Drs. John Layke and Payman Danielpour of Beverly Hills Plastic Surgery Group, sold direct to consumers.

name: Beverly Hills MD

reasons.compensation: 10% per sale with a 30-day cookie per Lasso's program listing.
reasons.contact_access: No public creator email found; access is through the Awin programme only.
reasons.credibility: Well-known direct-to-consumer brand from a Beverly Hills plastic surgery practice, though sold mainly through its own funnel pages.
reasons.niche_fit: Anti-aging skincare brand - a strong fit for mature-skincare creators.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open affiliate programme on Awin that publishers can apply to join.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A live network affiliate programme; no creator-specific ambassador structure was found.

description: Small family-run UK skincare brand founded by Joshua Osinaike with co-founder Aziza Williams, focused on everyday concerns including uneven-looking skin tone and dry skin for melanin-rich skin, made in the UK.

evidence.summary: JOSKN's own ambassador page publishes three commission tiers: 10% at Tier 1 (The Fresh Start), 15% at Tier 2 (The Glow Collective, with quarterly PR drops), and 20% at Tier 3 (The Luminary League), with an affiliate link and personal discount code; the APPLY NOW button routes to UpPromote (af.uppromote.com). No earnings-cap statement appears, so the cap is recorded as unknown.
The same page describes ambassador perks including early access to product drops and content briefs, a private ambassador email community, and chances to be featured on JOSKN's socials and website.

JOSKN's homepage describes it as 'a small, family-run UK skincare brand' founded by Joshua Osinaike with co-founder Aziza Williams, sourced in Ghana and made in the UK, with GBP pricing; its FAQ publishes admin@joskn.com.

name: JOSKN

reasons.compensation: Published tiers of 10/15/20% on the brand's own page (10% base recorded); no cap statement, so cap stays unknown.
reasons.contact_access: Open application page on the official site plus a published email (admin@joskn.com).
reasons.credibility: Small, young family-run brand - genuine but with a limited track record so far.
reasons.niche_fit: Pure skincare aimed at melanin-rich skin and everyday concerns - a focused, underserved creator niche.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Ambassador applications are publicly open via the brand's own page (UpPromote).
reasons.ugc_evidence: A structured three-tier ambassador program on the brand's own page with PR drops, content briefs and social/website features for ambassadors.

description: Estée Lauder skincare brand built on plant- and earth-based ingredients since 1990 - cleansers, serums, moisturizers and masks sold through origins.com and department stores.

evidence.summary: Lasso's listing for the Origins Online program gives 8% per sale with a 7-day cookie, and its join links point to FlexOffers (publisherpro.flexoffers.com).
Shopper quotes the Origins program at 5% per sale, conflicting with Lasso's 8%, so commission_rate is recorded as null; the same listing gives Origins' country as United States.
Origins' own site runs an 'Affiliate Partner Early Access' page, confirming the brand works with affiliate partners directly.

name: Origins

reasons.compensation: Rate could not be verified: Lasso lists 8% via FlexOffers while Shopper quotes 5%, so it is recorded as null and scored low.
reasons.contact_access: No public creator email found; access runs through the FlexOffers programme.
reasons.credibility: Estée Lauder brand selling since 1990 with global retail distribution.
reasons.niche_fit: Iconic plant-based skincare brand - near-perfect fit for skincare and clean-beauty creators.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Affiliate programme joinable via FlexOffers, subject to approval.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A network affiliate programme plus an affiliate partner page on the brand's own site; no open ambassador application was found.
